title: Mileage Surcharge Table for Member Freight Pickups of Northgate Special Orders
content:
This table applies to the member pickup fee that Northgate Purchases & Returns charges on the changed-mind freight pickup of Northgate Special Order merchandise for a consumer-segment membership (Northgate Student Club, Heroes Club, Club or Club Plus Membership).

## Distance surcharge on the member pickup

When the Northgate delivery appointment that delivered the purchase recorded a distance of more than 40 miles, 30.00 is added; when it recorded more than 20 and no more than 40 miles, 15.00 is added; otherwise, including a purchase delivered without a Northgate delivery appointment, nothing is added.

The distance is the one recorded on the Northgate Delivery & Installation appointment linked to the purchase; the surcharge is added to the member pickup fee.

| Distance recorded on the delivering appointment | Added to the member pickup fee |
|---|---|
| more than 40 miles | 30.00 |
| more than 20 miles, up to and including 40 miles | 15.00 |
| 20 miles or less | nothing |
| no Northgate delivery appointment | nothing |

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical distances)

| Recorded distance | Added |
|---|---|
| 40.0 miles | 15.00 |
| 40.5 miles | 30.00 |
| 20.0 miles | nothing |
| 20.2 miles | 15.00 |
